Package fr.imta.smartgrid.service

Class SensorService

java.lang.Object
fr.imta.smartgrid.service.SensorService
public class SensorService extends Object
Business service for CRUD operations on Sensor entities (SolarPanel, WindTurbine, EVCharger). Manages JPA transactions, measurement reception, and total production tracking.

    • createSolarPanel

      public SolarPanel createSolarPanel(String name, String description, Integer gridId, List<Integer> ownerIds, List<Integer> measurementIds, String powerSource, Float efficiency)
      Creates a new SolarPanel and persists it to the database.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the SolarPanel
      description - the description
      gridId - the ID of the associated Grid
      ownerIds - the list of owner Person IDs
      measurementIds - the list of Measurement IDs
      powerSource - the power source type
      efficiency - the panel efficiency
      Returns:
      the created SolarPanel
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any mandatory field is null
      jakarta.persistence.EntityNotFoundException - if the Grid, a Person, or a Measurement does not exist

    • receiveSolarPanelMeasurement

      public void receiveSolarPanelMeasurement(Integer id, Long timestamp, String name, Double value)
      Receives a measurement from a SolarPanel and persists the DataPoint. Updates the total production map if the measurement name is "power".
      Parameters:
      id - the ID of the SolarPanel
      timestamp - the timestamp of the measurement
      name - the measurement name ("power" or "temperature")
      value - the measured value
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no SolarPanel matches the given ID
